headline: Spiltan Acquires Majority Stake in Switch Nails at SEK 450 Million Valuation
summary: Swedish investment firm Investment AB Spiltan became the majority owner of cosmetics company Switch Nails. The investment transaction values the growing nail products business at 450 million Swedish kronor ($41 million).
why: Investment AB Spiltan is a Swedish investment group targeting growth companies across Northern Europe.

impacts.name: Investment AB Spiltan
impacts.why: Spiltan acquired majority control of Switch Nails in a deal valuing the enterprise at SEK 450M.
